versions.content: API Function Header File Description Dem _ Set - Event Status Dem.h Called by SW - Cs or BSW modules to report monitor status information to the Dem. BSW modules calling Dem_ Set Event Status can safely ignore the return value. This API will be available only if ({Dem/ Dem Config Set/ Dem Event Parameter/ Dem Event Reporting Type} == STANDARD_ REPORTING) Det _ Report - Runtime - Error Det.h Service to report runtime errors. If a callout has been configured then this callout shall be called.
